resources.string: App Permissions
These are the permissions Project Lumen may use and why it uses them. Most are only requested when you enable the related feature.
android.permission.CAMERA
Used on-device for distance-to-screen and blink/dry-eye detection. Frames are processed locally and are never saved or uploaded.
android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS
Remind you to rest, show Pomodoro status, and surface alerts.
android.permission.SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM
Fire rest and Pomodoro reminders at the exact scheduled time.
android.permission.USE_FULL_SCREEN_INTENT
Show a full-screen rest alert when it is time to take a break.
android.permission.SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW
Draw the eye-rest overlay over other apps when strict protection is active.
android.permission.WRITE_SETTINGS
Adjust screen brightness for auto-brightness eye protection.
android.permission.PACKAGE_USAGE_STATS
Optional; reads which app you are using so rest guidance can be app-aware.
android.permission.RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED
Restore your scheduled reminders after the device restarts.
android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE
Keep timers, camera, and light monitoring running reliably in the background while in use.
android.permission.INTERNET
Check for updates and, only if you enable them, upload optional diagnostics or sync your cloud account.
android.permission.ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE
Detect network availability for update checks and cloud sync.
android.permission.REQUEST_IGNORE_BATTERY_OPTIMIZATIONS
Keep reminder timers reliable by requesting exemption from aggressive battery optimization.
android.permission.USE_BIOMETRIC
Optional; protect sensitive settings with the device lock or biometric.
android.permission.REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES
Install the update APK you download from the official release page.
android.permission.VIBRATE
Vibrate when a rest reminder fires.
android.permission.QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES
Optional; list installed apps so per-app network control via Shizuku can work.
com.project.lumen.permission.ACCESS_LUMEN_CORE
Lets third-party apps you approve read Project Lumen status and control focus sessions through the open API.
com.project.lumen.permission.TRIGGER_LUMEN_CONTROL
Lets same-signature apps trigger rest-protection controls.
